Strategy: Combine the count-gated sweet band with a bonus for residuals that fit one or two more same-size items, keeping the mid penalty. This rewards two kinds of reusable leftovers at once, but the overlapping bonuses may blur the ranking and the limits are guesses.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) + (15 if r - item >= item and r - item < 3 * item else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
